we can not start with number, no special character, no space
we cant define variable in capital

-any value store in variable and variable assigned in memory.
-python has reserved keywords so we cant use as a variable.

****to switch in main branch****
git branch -M main
*** to list branch***
git branch

****Push all files on github****
git push -u origin main

    -git clone https://github.com/DEVENDRA-5470/Python-Assignments-109.git
*to check where code will push on github (How to check):
    -git remote -v

History Mismatch:
Diffrent file in loacal and Diffrent on github so it Mismatch.

*if github repo code and local Mismatch then first pull code from github where our 
local folder link with github repo.
github ke jis folder se humara github_practice folder link hai, waha (github) 
par agar code pehle se koi pda hua hai 
aur humne local pe jo link folder hai usme agar git clone karke kisi 
ka code leke aa gaye toh ---local and remote repo
se humari history mismatch hoti hai , that is the conflict.

 Solution:
 *Pull code from remote (from Github) to Local:
    -git pull origin main --allow-unrelated-histories

    git add "folder name"
    git commit -m "updated"
    git push -u origin main
    git push -f origin main  
 
2. How to set url 
    -git remote set-url origin https://github.com/DEVENDRA-5470/Python-Assignments-109.git
    -after set url we can push our code on another person github(DEVENDRA-5470).. 
    which we set already using set-url command
    -but we got message permission denied bacause i have no permission.

so we need to collaboration:

    -first hume github pe jana hoga jis repo ko clone kiya hai usme.
    setting me jayege --> collaborator --> add people (invite using username) --> accept

Fucntions:
    1. Every function has their own purpose.
    2. Function is block of instructions(code) which execute inside its own block.
    3. Function reusable means define one time use manytimes(dry)
    4. fucntion has two main parts first fucntion defination second fucntion calling.

    *Functions Divide into 4 Parts:
        1. take nothing return nothing.
        2. take nothing return something.
        3. take something return nothing.
        4. take something retrun something.

    -we use return method instead of print function in real scenarios.
    -fucntion is mainly use for automation we can run one function on multiple servers.
    -ex. server1, server2, server3
    -if we use return method, we use variable for calling function like ...res=add(2,3)
    -if we use return we can use varibale in another function.
    -if we pass default value is 0 then it will give ouput 0 if we not assign argumnets.
    -its use to avoid errors if we not pass anything in argumnets.

    **********python -m http.server 8080 to on our ip in browser***********

DATA STRUCTURE:
    -Data Structure used to store data effeciently and make faster for operations
     like Read and write
        1.List
            -List is a data structure in python used to store multiple data in of 
             different types in one variable.
            -List can define by using sqaure [] and data inside known a element.
            -list can be heterogenous and homogenous.
            -list are mutable.(changeable)
            -list support indexing, slicing and folllows ordering sequence.
            -indexing start from zero and length start from 1
            -length-1 = index.
            -Indexing is a position of value.
             ex. marks=[20,55,33,"hello",22,56]
            -Slicing means taking a part of data using indexes
            -start-include and stop-exclude
            # append
            # extend ...to remove nested list 
            # pop =remove end of the list and take position and give return
            #remove =no return value and remove with given element
